cueIntegration.protectedPathsNote: No server/cues/ directory or other Cue-runtime code exists in this repository or on any remote branch (checked: `ls server/cues`, `git ls-remote --heads origin`, `git grep server/cues`). Nothing was protected or modified on its behalf.
compatibleSeams: POST /mcp (OAuth 2.1 bearer, JSON-RPC tools/call) — the only programmatic write path for an external runtime; tools listed in apiRoutes
Agent runs: cue_record_run / cue_update_run / cue_list_runs / cue_get_run (AgentRun)
Assignments and hand-offs: cue_create_task / cue_list_tasks / cue_update_task (AgentTask)
Approval Center: cue_request_approval → (Carl decides in /cue/approvals) → cue_get_approval → cue_report_execution (ApprovalRequest)
Validated drafts: submit_outreach_draft, save_content_draft, create_draft_concept, save_research_draft, attach_research, save_content_opportunity
Context reads: get_client_context_pack, search_business_knowledge, get_opportunity, get_daily_briefing, cue_get_coordination_state
possibleConflicts: If the runtime persists its own AgentRun store, it must mirror runs into Command Center via cue_record_run/cue_update_run (or treat Command Center as the system of record); there is no bulk import endpoint.
AgentRun.status union is queued|running|completed|failed|cancelled — runtime states outside this set must be mapped.

ApprovalRequest.actionType union is fixed (email|post|proposal|dm|file|calendar|status_change|internal_task|other); new action kinds need a type + enum change in src/domain/entities2.ts and server/mcp.ts.
Cue agent ids are fixed: main|acquisition|creative|operations|content (src/domain/entities2.ts CUE_AGENTS).
OAuth tokens expire after 1 h (refresh 60 days); a headless runtime must handle refresh tokens. There is no API-key auth for server-to-server calls.
The legacy REST endpoints POST /api/ai/run and /api/manus/task are owner-session only and are not a runtime seam.
cueIntegration.requiredMigrationsNote: None. All records are generic rows in the D1 `records` table; new fields are optional and older records/exports load unchanged.
cueIntegration.approvalFlow: Runtime creates ApprovalRequest via cue_request_approval (status pending, payloadHash, targetRef, runId) → Carl approves (optionally editing the payload), rejects or requests changes in /cue/approvals, /tps/applications or the content calendar → decision appended to decisions[] with by='carl' and synced → runtime polls cue_get_approval; only status=approved with may_execute=true allows acting, using final_payload exactly → runtime executes externally (outside Command Center) → reports with cue_report_execution / record_outreach_sent (text must match the approved hash) / report_publication_result. Approving never sends, publishes, submits or changes an external account; for post targets it marks the post approved, for appdraft targets it marks the draft approved.

nextIntegrationSteps: Register the runtime as an OAuth client (POST /oauth/register), complete owner consent once, store the refresh token securely in the runtime.
Map runtime run states and agent ids onto AgentRun.status and CUE_AGENTS.
For every run, call cue_record_run (idempotency_key = runtime run id) and cue_update_run on completion with output and output_refs.

Route every external action through cue_request_approval with target_ref, run_id and idempotency_key; execute only after cue_get_approval returns may_execute=true; report via cue_report_execution / record_outreach_sent / report_publication_result.
Run tests/ops21-server.mjs against a staging Worker with the real runtime's client to confirm the contract.
Deploy only after explicit approval (npm run deploy).
